question: Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the series were to be continued? [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe4c2f6aea4e8ac2bba33970db3de72b5c43baf2a0b3a36e03f5cd6983151abb.png]
solution: The pattern followed here is: 1) Elements of 1st column and 3rd column are moving clockwise direction. Elements of 2nd column and 4th column are moving in anti-clockwise direction. • [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34f2353ef2602f51d7bdefaac8546dbdbb7601a0d6a7d5dce072ee7db6c6d767.png] 2) 1st, 2nd and 3rd rows follows different pattern. •
